items.title: Reduce Rework Ratio
items.rationale: Rework Ratio climbed 33% in the last 7 days.
suggested_experiments: Compare reopened or rewritten work against its original acceptance criteria.
Add a short pre-implementation alignment review for similar upcoming work.

items.title: Reduce Change Failure Rate
items.rationale: Change Failure Rate climbed 25% in the last 7 days.
suggested_experiments: Review recent failed changes for the earliest detectable signal before release.
Add one pre-release check to the riskiest deployment path.

items.title: Reduce Review Latency
items.rationale: Review Latency climbed 25% in the last 7 days.
suggested_experiments: Reserve a daily review block for PRs waiting longest for first response.
Pair authors with likely reviewers before opening complex PRs.

items.title: Reduce Code Churn
items.rationale: Code Churn climbed 25% in the last 7 days.
suggested_experiments: Review the files with the largest churn increase for unclear ownership or scope.
Timebox a design checkpoint before the next high-churn change expands.
